mapper.select: select (doc->'org'->'room')::text room from tenant_state where tenant_id = #{tid}
insert into ai_usage (tenant_id, day, calls) values (#{tid}, cast(#{day} as date), 1) on conflict (tenant_id, day) do update set calls = ai_usage.calls + 1 returning calls
mapper.update: update ai_usage set tin = tin + #{tin}, tout = tout + #{tout} where tenant_id = #{tid} and day = cast(#{day} as date)
mapper.select: select day::text, calls, tin::int, tout::int from ai_usage where tenant_id = #{tid} and day > current_date - 31 order by day desc
